games.name: Cash Pop (7AM)
games.jackpotDescription: Instant-multiplier variable-pick game — no jackpot/payout table (real prize is a random per-ticket multiplier the public draw data can't reveal).
games.payoutNote: 16 sessions/day (hourly 7AM-10PM PT, confirmed from oregonlottery.org's own text: "Pick a number from 1 – 15 and if it matches the number drawn, you win! ... DRAWINGS Hourly from 7 AM to 10 PM PT") — exceeds this project's standing ≤ 10-draws/day rule, built as an explicit user-reviewed exception for this one game. Real draw instant is :59 past the hour before the labeled session. Same membershipPick mechanic as every other state's Cash POP in this project.
